tools.name: technology_stack
tools.description: Detect a website’s CMS, frameworks and hosting technology for integration planning. 0.005 USDC per request.

tools.name: domain_profile
tools.description: Get technology, DNS, mail security, TLS and hosting findings in one domain profile. 0.035 USDC per request.

tools.name: ip_reputation
tools.description: Screen one IP for reputation risks for 0.001 USDC, or check a batch of up to 100 IPs for 0.050 USDC.

tools.name: speech_to_text
tools.description: Turn audio into timestamped text with optional speaker separation. Transcription: 0.020 USDC; speaker separation: 0.025 USDC per started minute (1–30).

tools.name: email_batch
tools.description: Check email syntax, domain routing and disposable-address signals in one batch. 0.0006 USDC per address, minimum 0.001 USDC per request; up to 100 addresses.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_batch · Public sink: email_batch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_batch · Public sink: email_batch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
